import os import subprocess from pathlib import Path import sys
try: # Validate environment variable program_files = os.environ.get("ProgramFiles") if not program_files: raise EnvironmentError("Environment variable 'ProgramFiles' is not set.")
# Construct paths script_name = Path(__file__).stem + ".py" file_path = os.path.join(program_files, "WhereScape", "GIT", "Python", "ed3d_commit_to_git.py") if not os.path.exists(file_path): raise FileNotFoundError(f"Script file not found: {file_path}")
base_dir = os.path.join(program_files, "WhereScape", "GIT", "Python", "python_embedded") python_exe_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "python.exe") if not os.path.exists(python_exe_path): raise FileNotFoundError(f"Python executable not found: {python_exe_path}")
command = [ python_exe_path, file_path, "--ws3d_repository", "$WSL_WRKFL_Repo$", "--ws3d_catagory", "$WSL_WRKFL_Category$", "--ws3d_model", "$WSL_WRKFL_Model$", "--ws3d_model_version", "$WSL_WRKFL_Version$", "--ws3d_commit_type", "Rebuild" ]
print (command) # Launch subprocess output = subprocess.Popen(command)#, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW) print(output.stderr)
except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] {type(e).__name__}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
